candidate_workaround: Decompose repository status and file discovery into separate bounded commands with explicit timeouts.
failure_signature: A compound Git status and file-listing probe exceeded its 10-second execution envelope before returning output.
recurrence_guard: Do not combine Git worktree inspection and recursive file discovery in one short-deadline shell invocation.
rollback: Terminate the timed-out read-only probe and discard its incomplete output; it changed no file, ref, index, or worktree.
scope_boundary: Owner-local x2 status inspection only; no scientific, professional, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Decompose compound repository inspection probes
trigger_preconditions: A repository inspection combines Git status and filesystem discovery under one short execution envelope.
